message: No detected input validation: User-supplied POST data is parsed with ast.literal_eval and used directly (e.g., as a ticker symbol or date string) with no schema, type, or range checks beyond what literal_eval itself enforces.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched from TradingView (pd.read_html), yfinance, and yahoo_fin without any checksum verification, authentication, or integrity validation of the retrieved content.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no label distribution comparison, validation of label values against an expected set, or use of any label-noise detection tool anywhere in the code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs only basic dropna() cleaning with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on the training data.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains/uses models via TensorFlow/Keras but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading any pretrained weights or serialized model artifacts.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard TensorFlow/Keras without any differential privacy library (e.g., TensorFlow Privacy, Opacus, or DP-SGD) applied to the training process.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or stress-test routines are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no isolated held-out test set enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics; the evaluation pipeline has no visible tamper-protection controls.

No detected input sanitization: Inputs from POST requests are parsed with ast.literal_eval but there is no validation of shape, type, range, or allowed ticker values before passing them to the model or yfinance/yahoo_fin calls.

No detected output bounds checks: The result of make_prediction is directly serialized with json.dumps and returned without any NaN guards, range checks, or sanity bounds on the model's predicted values.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is an LSTM for stock price prediction, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
